svg.title: I13 H1.1 trunk
svg.desc: One interactive SVG mapping I13 from the canonical thirteen words through the current OLOGY voxel and Cortex Verifier model.

g.text: one page · one SVG · trunk from root to current
12 semantic verbs + declaration keyword I = 13 · Block is container, not verb
32-bit surface root = [x:16 | y:16] · each vector roots a local voxel · c[v[ (), {}, () ]]cv
surface movement changes <x,y>; burrow keeps the same root
Python is loaded only when requested through Pyodide; the OLOGY/CV/Pulse Wasm micro-core is embedded directly in this SVG.
